items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Ed Lewis. ... If I asked Ed to sing a song here, now Ed's isn't a musician... Unless Ed's got something else.

ctx.x: It's really Armstrong's birthday. What's your name? Charlie DeVore. And yours?

I'm Dick Allen. Okay, what are we going to talk about today? How to learn how to play New Orleans jazz and how to set up a school, we hope, some sort of thing where we can have seminars and private lessons or what have you, and set up a band. What are your ideas on this, Charlie? You've had some experience.
